record.original_question: Let r >= 3 and let G be a K_{r+1}-free graph with m >= r + 1 edges. Must the sum of squares of the two largest adjacency eigenvalues satisfy lambda_1(G)^2 + lambda_2(G)^2 <= 2m(1 - 1/r)?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 4.2 (Bollobas and Nikiforov [2]). Let G be a Kr+1-free graph of size m >= r + 1. Then lambda1^2(G) + lambda2^2(G) <= 2m(1 - 1/r).
Lin, Ning and Wu [26] solved Conjecture 4.2 for r = 2 (see Theorem 2.3), and Conjecture 4.2 is still open for r >= 3.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $r \geq 3$ be an integer, and let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $n$ vertices with $m \geq r+1$ edges that contains no clique of size $r+1$ (i.e., $G$ is $K_{r+1}$-free). Let $A(G)$ denote the adjacency matrix of $G$, and let $\lambda_1(G) \geq \lambda_2(G) \geq \cdots \geq \lambda_n(G)$ be its eigenvalues. Prove or disprove that
$$\lambda_1(G)^2 + \lambda_2(G)^2 \leq 2m\left(1 - \frac{1}{r}\right).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The Bollobás–Nikiforov conjecture is established for r=2 (triangle-free case) by Lin, Ning, and Wu, and partial results exist (regular graphs, complete multipartite graphs, dense K_4-free graphs, graphs with few triangles, asymptotically almost surely for random graphs). For general r ≥ 3 the conjecture remains open as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: The Bollobás–Nikiforov Conjecture for Complete Multipartite Graphs and Dense K_4-Free Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: A stability result for K_4-free graphs... the conjecture holds for all K_4-free graphs with m = Ω(n^2) when n is sufficiently large.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results exist for r=3; the full conjecture for r ≥ 3 is not yet resolved.

status_evidence.title: Bollobás-Nikiforov Conjecture for graphs with not so many triangles
status_evidence.snippet: Verifies the conjecture under a bound on the number of triangles.
status_evidence.claim: Recent works continue to address the conjecture only under additional hypotheses, indicating it remains open in general.

status_evidence.title: Bollobás-Nikiforov conjecture holds asymptotically almost surely
status_evidence.snippet: Holds with probability tending to 1 for random graphs.
status_evidence.claim: The general conjecture for r ≥ 3 is still open.
